rubric: Derive the contract from the public request, issue-time owner decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require each outcome, boundary, error condition, and compatibility constraint only to the specificity those sources support; include resolved material decisions, but do not fill unresolved gaps by inference. Treat internal mechanisms, code structure, algorithms, representations, helper behavior, predicates broader than the requested case, messages, documentation, refactors, fixtures, and test organization as incidental unless independently required. Use later patches and tests only as evidence: they may confirm the requested outcome, its direct observable consequences, a closely analogous case, a defect mechanism, or preserved behavior, but cannot make their exact implementation, private assertions, chosen examples, or newly broadened coverage part of the contract. Penalize missing supported outcomes, unsupported scope expansion, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation producing the supported observable behavior.
